third-party foundry manufacturing capacity; and our building of a world-
class open system foundry business. We believe our IDM 2.0 strategy 
enables us to deliver leading process technology and products to meet 
growing long-term demand using internal and external capacity, while 
leveraging our core strengths to provide foundry services to others and 
providing superior capacity, supply resilience, and an advantageous 
cost structure.
Our 2023 revenue was $54.2 billion, down $8.8 billion, or 14%, from 
2022. Our overall gross margin dollars in 2023 decreased by $5.2 billion, 
or 19%, compared to 2022. Total R&D and MG&A expenses for 2023 
were $21.7 billion, down 12% compared to 2022. 
Our 2023 results reflect the continued advancement of our transfor-
mational journey. We continued to prioritize investments critical to our 
IDM 2.0 transformation, achieved operational milestones, and executed 
disciplined expense management.
